You are William, a soldier of the Grande Armée brought back from a battlefield grave. But the Europe you awaken to is not the one you sacrificed for. A mysterious plague now sweeps the continent, and you have been reborn with its corrupting power pulsing through your veins. HARNESS CORRUPTED POWER Each death is a chance to grow stronger. Master a combat system of parries, dashes, and visceral finishers across a variety of weapons. Channel your power to enhance attacks and unlock new supernatural abilities to inflict upon your enemies. SECRETS LITTER THE BATTLEFIELD Navigate a 19th-century alternate history where the costs of endless war have corrupted the landscape. Use your newfound mobility to outmaneuver the plague-ridden abominations of Napoleon’s Eternal Guard and uncover environmental secrets that may increase your chances of survival. UNCOVER A HORRID CONSPIRACY Witness a compelling story where historical figures and realities intertwine with elements of horror and the supernatural. Explore beyond the dark corners of the world to discover the truth behind the plague and your unholy resurrection. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREIn this bundleJust Dance: Decades of HitsView add-onJust Dance Free ExperienceView gameDescriptionIMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADES Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades. DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWS Celebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan-favorites like: - "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny - "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter - "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo & Don Omar - "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon - "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz - "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC - "Wannabe" by Spice Girls - "No Scrubs" by TLC - "It's Tricky" by Run DMC - "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel - "Mamma Mia" by ABBA AND MORE! From easy-to-follow to satisfyingly challenging, this year's track list is made to get players of all ages and styles dancing together! DISCOVER A FUN ADVENTURE FOR ALL GENERATIONS Explore the decades together in the new Adventure Mode. Discover 6 themed worlds, dance to iconic songs, enjoy fun mini-activities, and unlock exclusive rewards. Only available with Just Dance: Decades of Hits! ENDLESS WAYS TO PARTY Dance with up to 6 players locally, jump into Party Mode or get moving with Workout Mode. Grab your friends and family, choose your mode or dance, and let the party begin! Learn moreOnline multiplayer on console requires XBOX Game Pass Essential, Premium, or Ultimate (subscriptions sold separately).DETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionDeep Dish Dungeon is a dungeon crawler and exploration game that rewards curiosity and resourcefulness. In an atmospheric environment, explore corridors, rooms and passageways solo or with up to two friends, and gather resources to improve your camping site. Craft tools and cook nourishing meals to bolster strength throughout the journey, and unravel the enigma that lies within the shadows. Build, craft, cook Forage and scavenge as you traverse through the dungeon's bountiful depths. Between your journeys, return to camp and plan your next steps by the fire. Use the resources you find to craft new tools and cook a hearty meal. Remember that food is progress: over time, unlock recipes that have different effects on your stats. A massive dungeon to discover Fortune favors the bold. Take your time to investigate every shadow, solve every puzzle, and open every door. The dungeon will reveal its secrets only if you are patient and persistent. Learn how to defeat enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and never take a hint for granted. Explore together Any adventure is better with pals! Play with up to two friends and collaborate to unveil the secrets of the dungeon. Remember, co-op mode in Deep Dish Dungeon is not about competition, but connecting, sharing knowledge, and taking care of each other.Show morePublished byRaw Fury ABDeveloped byBehold StudiosPlay withPCXBOX Series X|SHandheldCapabilitiesOnline co-op (2-4)Single playerXbox cross-platform co-opXbox achievementsXbox cloud savesXbox Play AnywhereComing to these subscriptionsPC onlyUltimate XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads
